# Real Estate Dates

> Elite Dating & Networking for Real Estate Professionals

Real Estate Dates is an exclusive dating and networking application designed specifically for real estate professionals (brokers, agents, investors). It focuses on matching individuals with similar professional lifestyles, dealing with late closings and early showings. 

## Key Features
- Mutual Matching: Users must mutually like each other to unlock full biographies.
- Anti-Catfishing: Strict ID verification protocols to ensure genuine profiles.
- Tiered Access: Free ($0 - browse/swipe the deck, 5 message credits to start, AI Index % on every profile), Premium ($14.99/mo - unlimited keys, full galleries, unlimited chat, Video Date packs), Elite ($19.99/mo - everything in Premium plus unlimited Video Dates, unlimited stickers, Ballroom admission always included).
- Add-Ons: Text chat, video chat, and online speed dating available as add-ons.
- Add-ons: 3 Video Dates of 5 minutes ($5.99, Premium, one-time), Happy Hour Pass ($4.99), 5 Sticker Credits ($5). Message credit packs are no longer sold (Stripe prohibits pay-per-message processing); Free members start with 5 message credits and Premium includes unlimited chat.
- Premium Stickers: animated gold-medallion stickers (Flowers, Kiss, Hug, Smile, WOW, Heart, Cheers, Teddy, Fire, Sparkles, Golden Key, Dream Home, Deal, Crown) sendable in any match's chat for $1 each — free to receive, packs of 5 for $5, processed by Stripe and verified server-side.
- Exclusive Events: Online Happy Hour Speed Dating (see schedule below) and in-person walk-and-talk property dates.

## Happy Hour — The Ballroom (Live)
Happy Hour is a real scheduled event in the Ballroom, the speed-dating floor:
- Schedule: every Sunday, Monday, Wednesday and Friday — 1:30 PM ET (Miami time), DST-safe year-round.
- Countdown: opens at 6:00 PM — arrive early, settle in, see who else is coming.
- Rounds: seven 4-minute video dates, paired randomly and fairly. Never the same partner twice in one night.
- Entry: Elite members always in; others unlock with a $4.99 pass.
- Scorecard: during every date, privately tap Like or Not-for-me. No one sees your marks — not your dates, not other members.
- Results: mutual Keys connect instantly during the event — chat opens on the spot with messaging, stickers, and video calls under your plan; final results appear right after the last round.
- Between rounds, the next date starts automatically. No tapping, no hunting.
- Always free minutes-wise: Ballroom speed dating never consumes video minutes.

## Video Calls & Minutes
- Elite members: unlimited Video Dates.
- Video Add-on (any plan): 100 minutes for $5.99 — one-time, never expires, stacks.
- Add-on minutes are used first; remaining minutes show inside every call; warning at 5 minutes left.
- All calls are private, encrypted, and require both members to be matched.

## Target Audience
Real estate agents, luxury brokers, investors, and professionals in the real estate industry looking to date, network, and build an empire together.
